newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian forex market closed for ANZAC Day.
newsitem.headline: Australian forex market closed for ANZAC Day.

text.p: The Australian foreign exchange market is closed on Friday for the ANZAC Day public holiday.
On Thursday, the Australian dollar suffered another session of hesitation as support proved just as stubborn as resistance in trade that was very much two-way.

Sellers were encouraged by speculation the Reserve Bank would yet cut domestic interest rates following favourable inflation and wages news this week. But bears were met by solid demand at US$0.7740 and the market mood was made extra cautious by talk an Asian name was protecting a large strangle option.
